attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'EOF'
from expr_eval import evaluate

cases = [
    ("1 + 2 * 3", 7),
    ("(1 + 2) * 3", 9),
    ("10 - 4 - 3", 3),
    ("2 * (3 + 4) - 5", 9),
    ("100", 100),
    ("-3 + 5", 2),
    ("1 - -2", 3),
    ("((2))", 2),
    ("2*3+4*5", 26),
    (" ( 1 + 2 ) * ( 3 - 4 ) ", -3),
    ("7", 7),
    ("(((1+2)*(3+4)))", 21),
]
for expr, expected in cases:
    got = evaluate(expr)
    assert got == expected, f"{expr!r}: expected {expected}, got {got}"

for bad in ["", "   ", "1 +", "(1+2", "1 & 2", "1 2", "*", "1 + * 2", "1)", "a+b"]:
    try:
        evaluate(bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"expected ValueError for {bad!r}")

print("all tests passed")
EOF"}
